_: Titles marked mature (isAdult, so the default-off 'Show mature collections' setting hides them everywhere and no channel airs them) on evidence that the film shows nudity or sexual content, where no keyword rule can see it. Owner, 2026-09-29: 'If you have knowledge that a movie is mature then it should be hidden from recommendations.' Keys are an archiveID or an IMDb id (every upload of that film); each value names its evidence: the film's own synopsis, its rating, or a page a reader can open. Never a hunch. A synopsis word alone is not evidence: 'naked eye', newsreels of camps and medical films use the same words. Applied by tools/remediate_catalog.py is_adult_signal.
